description: Remaining screens (History, Stats, Profile/Settings), the offline fallback page, and the README; plus the final whole-app constraint sweep. PlanPicker owns the custom-hours input (the only place custom becomes selectable, completing Finding 2). Depends on FEAT-005/004/003/002. Grounded in design.md Sections 3, 10, 14, 20 and requirements FR4/FR5/FR6/FR7/FR9/FR10.
steps: Create src/app/history/page.tsx + src/features/history/HistoryList.tsx (useLiveQuery(() => db.sessions.orderBy('startMs').reverse().toArray()), grouped by day via src/lib/time.ts helpers; friendly empty state) and SessionRow.tsx (duration, plan label, completed badge with IoCheckmarkCircle, delete via ConfirmDialog -> sessions.remove).

Create src/app/stats/page.tsx + src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx (current streak, longest streak, total fasts, total hours, average length from src/lib/stats via useLiveQuery; plus the profiling goal read from the store and mapped through GOAL_LABELS, with a 'Belum ada tujuan' placeholder when profiling is null) and WeeklyBarChart.tsx (custom SVG/div last-7-days bars from weekly(sessions, now); NO charting library).

Create src/app/profile/page.tsx + src/features/settings/PlanPicker.tsx (switch active plan; it OWNS the custom fasting-hours input clamped 8..23 — the only place custom is selectable, completing Finding 2; shows the 5:2 info card), DailyGoalPicker.tsx (set daily goal hours), ReminderSettings.tsx (permission request + schedule toggles; friendly emoji-free copy for denied/unsupported, never blocks), AboutCard.tsx (version/about). Profile also offers re-run profiling (navigates to /onboarding?rerun=1) and reset-all data via ConfirmDialog (clears IndexedDB + persisted Zustand state).
Create src/app/offline/page.tsx (folder 'offline') per Section 3: the emoji-free offline fallback precached by Serwist.
Ensure all empty/loading states across these screens use the Gojek voice from copy.ts with no emoji (FR9/AC... ).

Create README.md (Indonesian) per Section 20: what Heula is; run instructions (npm install, npm run dev, npm run build, npm start, npm test); full feature list; the no-emoji + react-icons/io5 constraints; data is on-device/offline; reminders are best-effort client-side; plus the manual smoke checklist (onboarding gating, timer->Dexie, live history delete, theme persistence, offline shell after build).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes with zero TypeScript errors and no build-breaking lint.
`npm run test` passes all Vitest suites including the no-emoji scan.

History groups sessions by day with duration/plan/completed badge and supports delete-with-confirm; Stats shows streaks/totals/average + a last-7-days chart rendered without a charting library + the profiling goal; Profile can switch plan (incl. custom hours), set daily goal, toggle dark mode, manage reminders, re-run profiling, and reset all data with confirmation (manual smoke matches AC12/AC13/AC14).
An emoji scan of the whole source tree + README finds zero emoji; a search finds no import from lucide-react or any icon path other than react-icons/io5 (AC19/AC20).
README.md exists in Indonesian with run instructions and the feature list (NFR9).
verification: Run `npm install` then `npm run build` and confirm zero TypeScript errors and no build-breaking lint, with public/sw.js emitted (NFR1/AC1/AC16).
Run `npm run test` and confirm all suites pass.

Run the emoji sweep `grep -rIlP "[\x{1F000}-\x{1FAFF}\x{2600}-\x{27BF}\x{2190}-\x{21FF}\x{2B00}-\x{2BFF}\x{FE0F}\x{2764}]" src README.md` and confirm no output; run `grep -rn lucide src` (no matches) and `grep -rn "react-icons/" src` (only react-icons/io5).
findings: Implemented History (src/app/history/page.tsx + src/features/history/{HistoryList,SessionRow}): useLiveQuery over db.sessions.orderBy('startMs').reverse().toArray(), grouped by day via src/lib/time.ts (dayKey/formatDate) with Hari ini/Kemarin headings, friendly empty state, and delete-with-ConfirmDialog -> sessions.remove. Stats (src/app/stats/page.tsx + src/features/stats/{StatsOverview,WeeklyBarChart}): streaks/totals/average from src/lib/stats via useLiveQuery; profiling goal read from the store and mapped through GOAL_LABELS with a 'Belum ada tujuan' placeholder; WeeklyBarChart is a plain-div column chart from weekly(sessions, now) with NO charting library. Profile (src/app/profile/page.tsx + src/features/settings/{PlanPicker,DailyGoalPicker,ReminderSettings,AboutCard}): PlanPicker owns the custom-hours input clamped 8..23 (the only place custom becomes selectable, completing Finding 2) and shows the 5:2 info card; DailyGoalPicker stepper 8..23; ReminderSettings does lazy permission request + toggles with friendly denied/unsupported copy that never blocks (permission read in useEffect to avoid SSR mismatch); AboutCard shows version/about; Profile also offers re-run profiling (push /onboarding?rerun=1), theme Segmented, and reset-all via ConfirmDialog -> resetAll (clears Dexie + persisted store, then replace /onboarding). Offline fallback src/app/offline/page.tsx already present and emoji-free. Added history/stats/settings copy blocks + expanded settings copy in src/lib/copy.ts (centralized, emoji-free). Wrote README.md in Indonesian per Section 20 (what Heula is, run instructions, feature list, no-emoji + react-icons/io5 constraints, on-device/offline data, best-effort reminders, manual smoke checklist). Verification all green: npm install ok; npm run build zero TS errors, no build-breaking lint (only two pre-existing no-unused-vars warnings in notifications.ts/recommendation.ts), public/sw.js emitted (42KB); npm run test 148/148 pass including the 64-file no-emoji scan; emoji sweep over src+README no matches; grep lucide src none; react-icons/ in src only react-icons/io5 (Icon.tsx).
